components.summary: Public lazy API, CLI dispatch and fuel-cell example
responsibilities: Expose the native API through literal lazy owner exports
Dispatch CLI leaves to qualification, mesh, blueprint, revision and identity owners
Construct the packaged fuel-cell example without adding domain semantics
side_effects: Read declared CLI inputs; emit native reports

components.summary: Shared contracts, reports, status and semantic execution
responsibilities: Derive required Guards from claim atoms and validate shared contract shapes
Execute native Event, Agent, Space, Resource, Causal, Conflict and Norm semantics
Keep shared ledgers, reports, provider/current-input identities and status aggregation
state: Immutable contract, report and execution-evidence values
side_effects: Read declared mapping files and emit JSON only when requested

components.summary: Seven structural Guards and their native family oracle catalog
responsibilities: Run the seven named structural Guard checks with shared errors and ledgers
Maintain native good cases and protected failure-class oracles without author-supervision proof
side_effects: Return structural results; explicit family check executes its finite native cases

components.summary: Unit qualification and exact provider/currentness boundaries
responsibilities: Qualify a unit from its derived Guard obligations and supplied provider evidence
Keep native semantic status, provider identity and current-input gaps separate
Expose the run_worldguard kernel through one qualification owner
side_effects: Execute selected native Guards and return a bounded report

components.summary: Model mesh ownership, handoffs and predictive depth
responsibilities: Validate model authority, ports, handoffs, freshness and graph structure
Run per-node native qualification with complete per-variable/timepoint predictive coverage
Build native execution-depth evidence without author-tool transport
Validate the existing native depth producer shape and current mesh/coverage identity without rerunning owners
state: Model and evidence identities carried in immutable mesh reports
side_effects: Execute declared native mesh nodes and emit in-memory evidence

components.summary: WorldBlueprint hierarchy, behavior cases, census, impact and trace
responsibilities: Validate hierarchical world elements and typed input/output/dependency bindings
Execute actual behavior cases and preserve independent test/evidence and signed census boundaries
Answer affected impact and reverse trace from qualified current-input identities
Expose optional FlowGuard identity projection without claiming independent provider execution
state: Blueprint identities and independently signed object census values
side_effects: Read declared evidence files; execute explicit behavior/test bindings; return reports

components.summary: Task-local prediction, reversible revision and fact transactions
responsibilities: Freeze prediction before observation and compare declared world coverage
Validate complete reusable native mesh receipts against current candidate bytes/coverage and bind independent holdout evidence to candidate revisions
Preview subordinate four-valued fact transactions and activate only against current evidence
state: Immutable prediction, observation, revision and fact-snapshot values
side_effects: Return candidate activation or rollback results without an implicit persistent store

components.summary: Native template registry, exact selection and instance construction
responsibilities: Select zero, one or many native template fragments with explicit ownership
Compose fragments, resolve typed slots and validate native Guard/mesh routes
Keep construction identity separate from semantic, provider and predictive closure
state: Template registry, manifest and instance fingerprints
side_effects: Construct deterministic in-memory native contract scaffolding

components.summary: Publish one validated source patch identity
responsibilities: Check source/version/changelog identity and frozen main
Create stable GitHub tag and Release at that same commit
side_effects: Explicit release commit or manual workflow publishes with GitHub token

components.summary: Canonical runtime projection and read-only identity utilities
responsibilities: Synchronize the portable runtime only from canonical worldguard source
Compare current source/package/explicit installation bytes across the full runtime tree
Refresh bounded native test fixtures through their existing utilities
side_effects: Explicit sync replaces the portable projection; identity audit remains read-only

components.summary: Portable skill launchers and routing audits
responsibilities: Select the bundled CLI without a package fallback
Audit exact internal Guard routes, task shapes and conditional references
Keep selected contract, blueprint and final-reporting instructions aligned with native execution and target-local evidence boundaries
side_effects: Run only the selected native CLI and emit routing reports
